source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Frame, p.2-4

procedures.title: Frame dimensions: Corvette

specs.what: top view: centerline to front frame hole (each side)
top view: centerline to body mount hole near transverse reference line
top view: centerline to rear hole CW / CX (each side)
top view: front frame hole to transverse reference line
top view: body mount hole ahead of transverse reference line
top view: transverse reference line to rear hole CW
side view: front frame hole to transverse reference line
side view: front frame hole height above datum
side view: hole at kick-up height above datum
side view: height above datum at kick-up (upper point)

notes: See figure 3 in the manual; dimensions are printed without units (inches).
Frame centerline is set by the center of hole CY (on the front crossmember) and by being equidistant from rear holes CX and CW.
Dimension descriptions are read from the figure; check the figure for the exact end points.
